claim.claim-text: 2. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 1, wherein the tip has a vertex conforming to the inner wall or outer wall of the rivet shank or between the inner wall and the outer wall.
3. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 1, wherein the directed concave or convex surfaces is a non-mirror symmetric structure.

4. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 1, wherein the rotatory driving structure has several wedge-shaped notches, plum blossom shaped bosses or a plum blossom shaped grooves evenly distributed along the circumferential direction.

5. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 4, wherein the wedge-shaped notch has two intersecting planes, one of which is perpendicular to the surface of the rivet head, designed for bearing the circumferential torque, and the other one is tilted from the surface of the rivet head to the lower end for dynamic matching.

6. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 4, wherein the plum blossom shaped bosses contain several petals evenly distributed along circumferential direction, which are used to bear circumferential torques.

7. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 4, wherein the plum blossom shaped grooves contain several petals evenly distributed along circumferential direction, which are used to bear circumferential torques.
8. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 1, wherein the positioning structure is a cone shaped groove or a conical protruding platform.

9. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 8, wherein the cone shaped groove is coaxial with the semi-hollow rivet shank to ensure that the rotation axis of the rivet is coincided with its geometric axis when the driving torque is applied.

10. The friction self-piercing rivet of claim 8, wherein the conical protruding platform is coaxial with the semi-hollow rivet shank to ensure that the rotation axis of the rivet is coincided with its geometric axis when the driving torque is applied.
13. The F-SPR system of claim 11, wherein the wedge-shaped notch and wedge-shaped protrusion have chamfering on each edge for avoiding over positioning.
14. The F-SPR system of claim 11, wherein the die has an upper surface designing with fixed structures on the top end to control the flow of the workpieces.
15. The F-SPR system of claim 14, wherein the fixed structure includes a concave die with a flat surface, a pip die, a die with a concave flat bottom and a die with a through hole.
